description:
Required step before mailing letters. Renders the letter with the first recipient's real data in its letter type's layout, checks which owners have mailing addresses, estimates the cost from the user's plan (Insert Blank Page letters include the extra address page), and returns a confirmation_token.

Show the preview, then ask the user to approve. Only after they approve, call spur_send_letters with the token (the widget's Send button does the same). The token expires in 30 minutes and only covers this exact template, letter type, print options, recipient set and return address.

color.description: Print in color (false for black and white)

double_sided.description: Print on both sides of each sheet

return_address_id.description: Defaults to the user's default return address

template_id.description: Letter template id (UUID from a Spur list/search tool)

name: spur_preview_letter_campaign
title: Preview letter mailing
